name: BEEP.rent
tagline: Search and book rental cars in Poland; agent developers can earn commission with partner API keys.
description:
BEEP.rent's first-party remote MCP server searches and compares rental cars in Poland, reads full offer prices, deposits and policies, prepares checkouts, and supports booking and reservation management. Pickups are in Poland; prices are in PLN. Payments are completed on beep.rent.

Public search and offer tools work without an API key. Account-linked tools use BEEP ID OAuth. Booking, cancellation and extension tools require the user's explicit authorization as described by each tool.

Agent developers can join the BEEP Partner Programme and use a partner API key for attribution. The standard commission is 10% of the net rental value of eligible completed and settled rentals, excluding VAT and deposits, subject to programme terms. See https://beep.rent/pl-pl/program-partnerski/agenci-ai/ and https://beep.rent/pl-pl/regulamin-programu-partnerskiego/.

install.notes: Connects directly over Streamable HTTP. Public search needs no API key. For partner attribution, configure an Authorization: Bearer <your-partner-api-key> header in your client. Account-linked reservation tools require BEEP ID sign-in. Setup: https://beep.rent/en-pl/ai-agents/
